title: MOXIR 17.10 — Known · full — the patch AS DOCUMENTED (index-order packing, not yet a data-run plan)
status: AS DOCUMENTED. This file writes down the addresses the project document already holds (U1 1-512, U2 1-176, fixture numbers 1-68), so that patch-sheet.mjs can check the desk against them and desk-plan.mjs can load them exactly. It is NOT the data-run plan the audit owes (docs/ai/audits/moxir-2026-10-05/B-show-control.md W1: one universe per cable run, half of every universe spare, splitters). When that plan is written, it replaces this file and patch-plan.mjs re-addresses the document.
howToRead: docs/architecture/RIG_BUILD.md §19 (the plan format) and §19.5 (loading a chosen version onto its desk: scripts/rigbuild/desk-plan.mjs). Running patch-plan.mjs with this file changes nothing in the document (0 ops): every block reproduces the address, fixture number and unit the document has.
method: Blocks select lamps by their entity group (<group>-NN) and keep the order the document numbers them in; every start, fixture number and order was read off the document (local install, version 2, 2026-10-05) and checked by running planPatch against it (0 ops, 0 errors).
Off-DMX lamps (6 LaserCube, 6 hazers, 4 smoke machines: components.fixture.dmx = false) take no address and are in no block.
Known limits, owed: U1 has 0 channels spare and carries 57 units on one line (over the DMX512-A 32 unit-load guide without a splitter); U3 and U4 of the 4-port node are unused.

node.what: one 4-port Art-Net node at the booth (planning equivalent: Luminex LumiNode 4; in the order as one row, model not chosen)
node.protocol: Art-Net 4 (sACN E1.31 also possible — the desk sends either)
node.numbering: desk universe U1 = Art-Net Port-Address 0 (Net 0 · Sub-Net 0 · Universe 0) = sACN universe 1; U2 = Port-Address 1 = sACN 2
node.splitters: OWED: no splitter is in the order; U1 needs one (57 units on one line).
